posts.post_caption:
Someone just open-sourced a GitHub repo that lets you spin up an entire AI company. With AI employees.
Engineers, designers, growth marketers, product managers. Each one runs as its own agent. And they coordinate with each other to ship real ideas.
This thing got 10,000 stars in under a week.
The engineering department alone has 7 agents. Design has 7. Marketing has 8. Product management, testing, support, spatial computing. Over 50 agents total across every department you'd find in a real company.
Instead of one big AI trying to do everything, this structures it like an actual org chart. Specialized agents, clear roles, workflows between them.
You give it an idea. The product agents scope it. The engineers build it. The designers design it. The marketers figure out how to launch it.
One person with this repo has the output of a 50-person startup.
Greg Isenberg said it best. The future belongs to the people who tinker with software like this.
Comment "AGENTS" and I'll send you the repo link.
